keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Own Goal by Castello Lukeba, RB Leipzig. RB Leipzig 0, Manchester City 1.
First Half ends, RB Leipzig 0, Manchester City 1.
Neil El Aynaoui (RB Leipzig) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! RB Leipzig 1, Manchester City 1. Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) right footed shot from a difficult angle on the right to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Brajan Gruda following a fast break.
Substitution, RB Leipzig. Christopher Nkunku replaces Christoph Baumgartner.
Goal! RB Leipzig 1, Manchester City 2. Enzo Fernández (Manchester City) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Iliman Ndiaye with a cross.
Goal! RB Leipzig 2, Manchester City 2. Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Christopher Nkunku.
Substitution, Manchester City. Jérémy Doku replaces Phil Foden.
Substitution, RB Leipzig. Tidiam Gomis replaces Rômulo.
Substitution, RB Leipzig. Rocco Reitz replaces Antonio Nusa.
Substitution, RB Leipzig. Benjamin Henrichs replaces Ridle Baku.
Substitution, RB Leipzig. Nicolas Seiwald replaces Neil El Aynaoui.
David Raum (RB Leipzig) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! RB Leipzig 2, Manchester City 3. Erling Haaland (Manchester City) left footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Elliot Anderson.
Substitution, Manchester City. Rúben Dias replaces Matheus Nunes.
Substitution, Manchester City. Ayyoub Bouaddi replaces Elliot Anderson.
Substitution, Manchester City. Mateo Kovacic replaces Enzo Fernández.
Substitution, Manchester City. Allan replaces Iliman Ndiaye.
Jérémy Doku (Manchester City) is shown the yellow card.
